name.ja: VOF法／体積率による界面捕獲

summary.ja: セル内の流体体積率で界面を表す方法。レベルセット法との保存性・幾何表現・曲率評価の違いを比較解説する。VOF専用コードと数値比較は未収録。
summary.en: Represent an interface through cell fluid-volume fractions. Compare conservation, geometric representation and curvature evaluation with level sets. No dedicated VOF implementation or numerical comparison is included.

references.label: S. Osher and J. A. Sethian (1988). Fronts propagating with curvature-dependent speed: Algorithms based on Hamilton-Jacobi formulations.
references.scope: Selected author-hosted original passages: abstract, implicit front representation and Hamilton–Jacobi transport/normal-motion formulation. No full-paper audit or reproduction of its full experiment suite.

references.label: C. W. Hirt and B. D. Nichols (1981). Volume of fluid (VOF) method for the dynamics of free boundaries.
references.scope: Publisher bibliography and abstract for the original volume-fraction formulation. No full-text algorithm audit or implementation of its donor–acceptor scheme.

references.label: M. Sussman and E. Fatemi (1999). An Efficient, Interface-Preserving Level Set Redistancing Algorithm and Its Application to Interfacial Incompressible Fluid Flow.
references.scope: Official abstract and bibliography: redistancing quality includes retaining the zero interface; its constrained higher-order algorithm is not the simple Godunov auxiliary iteration implemented here.

references.label: M. Sussman and E. G. Puckett (2000). A Coupled Level Set and Volume-of-Fluid Method for Computing 3D and Axisymmetric Incompressible Two-Phase Flows.
references.scope: Author-hosted pp.302–305, equations(1)–(6),(9),(12),(15): signed-distance geometry, enclosed-mass issue and volume-fraction conservation. Sign is reversed here to make phi negative inside. No CLSVOF or two-phase fluid experiment executed.

assumptions: Prescribed sufficiently regular velocity and resolved interface. Dedicated examples use a fixed unit square, analytic exterior data and rigid circle kinematics.
assumptions_ja: 十分に正則な指定速度と解像された界面。専用例は単位正方形・解析的な外部境界値・円の剛体運動に限定。
units: Examples are nondimensional. A distance-like phi has length units in dimensional formulations; a volume fraction is dimensionless.
units_ja: 実行例は無次元。次元付き定式化の距離型φは長さ、体積率は無次元。
boundary_conditions: Dedicated level-set examples prescribe analytic exterior ghost data at every RK stage; no periodic or general two-phase-flow validation.
boundary_conditions_ja: 専用レベルセット例は全RK段の外側ゴースト値を解析的に指定。周期条件・一般二相流の検証ではない。

limitations.ja: VOFとの比較は定式化と適用条件の解説です。VOFやCLSVOFの実装・性能測定、曲率流・二相流・合体分裂の数値検証はありません。
limitations.en: VOF/CLSVOF comparisons describe formulations and conditions. No VOF implementation, performance ranking, curvature-flow, two-phase-flow or topology-change validation is claimed.

metadata_review.level: Selected original-source passages and explicit implementation boundary; dedicated level-set release independently extracted and rerun with22 tests.
